name: Diptirekha Das

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Diptirekha Das writes poetry in Odia and English and also works as a blogger. Her Literary Vibes contributor biography places her in Bhubaneswar and records postgraduate study in economics at Utkal University. The journal published ‘Healing Is Not Linear!’ and ‘The Forgotten Spring’, poems concerned with loss and the changing natural world.

Her Kabita Live poems ask what relationships need in order to endure. ‘The Pain Of Unsaid Words’ urges attention to people before the chance to listen is lost. ‘Don’t Set The Rules For Her’ shifts towards trust and personal freedom, ending with an image of flight and return. Together they place care alongside the need to leave another person room to breathe.
